channel.title: Treasure Coast Today
channel.description: Local news for Martin, St. Lucie and Indian River counties, Florida.

item.title: Fourth of July cookout costs rise 4% as inflation drives up ground beef, buns and strawberries
item.description: A Fourth of July cookout for 10 people now costs $73.82, up 4% from last year, according to the American Farm Bureau Federation's Summer Cookout Cost Survey.

item.title: Palm Beach County schools earn third consecutive A rating from state
item.description: The School District of Palm Beach County received an A rating from the state for the third year in a row, with 143 district-operated schools rated A or B and a record 93.5% graduation rate.

item.title: Juno Beach fence dispute at JB-7 beach access could cost town thousands
item.description: Residents at the Colony Condos say beachgoers are cutting through their private property since the town removed a fence at the JB-7 public walkway in 2023, sparking confrontations and police calls.

item.title: Riviera Beach named only Florida city to receive 2026 All-America City Award
item.description: Riviera Beach was selected as one of just 10 communities nationwide to receive the prestigious All-America City Award from the National Civic League, recognizing efforts to strengthen community engagement and civic health.

item.description: Martin County Maritime Response Unit will have two boats with medics on standby in the north and south of the county as hundreds of boaters are expected to celebrate on the water this Fourth of July weekend.

item.title: Hobe Sound community rallies around man who lost fiance in deadly home fire
item.description: Misty Dawn White, 46, was found dead Monday after a fire broke out inside the couple's home in Hobe Sound. Friends have launched a fundraiser to help her fiance Mark rebuild after the flames destroyed their belongings.

item.title: Fort Pierce breast cancer patient and surgeon speak out after insurance denial hours before reconstruction surgery
item.description: Beth Clark, 48, was denied coverage by Anthem Blue Cross and Blue Shield for a reconstruction procedure using GalaFlex mesh less than 24 hours before it was scheduled, prompting her surgeon to call for policy changes.

item.title: Florida waives admission fees at state parks for America's 250th Independence Day weekend
item.description: The Florida Department of Environmental Protection waived admission fees at Florida State Parks from Friday through Sunday to celebrate America's semiquincentennial, giving residents and visitors free access to beaches, springs, trails and historic sites.

item.title: DeSantis signs $117.6 billion Florida budget with $810 million in vetoes, fourth consecutive spending cut
item.description: Gov. Ron DeSantis signed a $117.6 billion state budget this week, marking the fourth consecutive year Florida's spending plan has shrunk. The Governor vetoed nearly $810 million in line-item appropriations, plus another $750 million the Legislature wanted to transfer into the state's rainy-day fund.
